title: Dua Asharat
data:
The Supplication of the Tens; some of its passages are repeated ten times each. This version — there being some difference among its transmitted copies — follows Shaykh al-Tusi's Misbah al-Mutahajjid. It is advisable to say it every morning and evening, though its best time is Friday afternoon:
بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَ اللهُ اَكْبَرُ وَ لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ
BISMIL LAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM SUBHAANAL LAAHI WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI WA LAA ILAAHA ILLAL LAAHU WALLAAHO AKBAR WA LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAHIL A'LIYYIL A'ZEEM
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the All-magnificent.
سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ اٰنَاۤءَ اللَّيْلِ وَ اَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَ الْاٰصَالِ
SUBHAANAL LAAHI AANAAA-AL LAYLI WA ATRAAFAN NAHAAR SUBHAANAL LAAHI BIL GHUDUWWI WAL AASAAL
Glory be to Allah in the hours of the night and the two ends of the day; glory be to Allah in the early morning and the evening,
سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَ الْاِبْكَارِ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ حِيْنَ تُمْسُوْنَ وَ حِيْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ
SUBHAANAL LAAHI BIL A'SHIYYI WAL IBKAAR SUBHAANAL LAAHI HEENA TUMSOONA WA HEENA TUSBIHOON
glory be to Allah at nightfall and daybreak, glory be to Allah when you enter the evening and when you enter the morning,
وَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ عَشِيَّا وَ حِيْنَ تُظْهِرُوْنَ
WA LAHUL HAMDU FIS SAMAAWAATI WAL ARDI WA A'SHIYYAW WA HEENA TUZHIROON
and unto Him is praise in the heavens and the earth, at nightfall and at noon,
يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَ يُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَ يُحْيِيْ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَ كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ
YUKHRIJUL HAYYA MINAL MAYYITI WA YUKHRIJUL MAYYITA MINAL HAYYI WA YUHYIL ARDA BA'DA MAWTIHAA WA KAZAALIKA TUKHRAJOON
He brings forth the living from the dead and brings forth the dead from the living, and He revives the earth after its death; and even so shall you be brought forth.
سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ وَ سَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
SUBHAANA RABBIKA RABBIL I'ZZATI A'MMAA YASIFOON WA SALAAMUN A'LAL MURSALEENA WAL HAMDU LILLAAHI RABBIL A'ALAMEEN
Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Might, above what they attribute to Him; and peace be upon the messengers, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمُلْكِ وَ الْمَلَكُوْتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْعِزَّةِ وَ الْجَبَرُوْتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْكِبْرِيَاۤءِ وَ الْعَظَمَةِ
SUBHAANA ZIL MULKI WAL MALAKOOT SUBHAANA ZIL I'ZZATI WAL JABAROOT SUBHAANA ZIL KIBRIYAAA-I WAL A'ZAMAH
Glory be to the Lord of the kingdom and the dominion, glory be to the Lord of might and sovereignty, glory be to the Lord of majesty and greatness,
الْمَلِكِ الْحَقِّ الْمُهَيْمِنِ الْقُدُّوْسِ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَيِّ الَّذِيْ لَا يَمُوْتُ سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَيِّ الْقُدُّوْسِ
AL-MALIKIL HAQQIL MUHAYMINIL QUDDOOS SUBHAANAL LAAHIL MALIKIL HAYYIL LAZEE LAA YAMOOT SUBHAANAL LAAHIL MALIKIL HAYYIL QUDDOOS
the True Sovereign, the Guardian, the Holy. Glory be to Allah, the Ever-living Sovereign Who never dies; glory be to Allah, the Ever-living, Holy Sovereign.
سُبْحَانَ الْقَاۤئِمِ الدَّاۤئِمِ سُبْحَانَ الدَّاۤئِمِ الْقَاۤئِمِ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيْمِ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْاَعْلٰى
SUBHAANAL QAAA-IMID DAAA-IM SUBHAANAD DAAA-IMIL QAAA-IM SUBHAANA RABBIYAL A'ZEEM SUBHAANA RABBIYAL A'LAA
Glory be to the Ever-standing, the Everlasting; glory be to the Everlasting, the Ever-standing; glory be to my Lord, the Most Great; glory be to my Lord, the Most High,
سُبْحَانَ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ سُبْحَانَ الْعَلِيِّ الْاَعْلٰى سُبْحَانَهُ وَ تَعَالٰى سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ رَبُّنَا وَ رَبُّ الْمَلَاۤئِكَةِ وَ الرُّوْحِ
SUBHAANAL HAYYIL QAYYOOM SUBHAANAL A'LIYYIL A'LAA SUBHAANAHU WA TA-A'ALAA SUBBOOHUN QUDDOOSUR RABBUNAA WA RABBUL MALAAA-IKATI WAR ROOH
glory be to the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting; glory be to the Most High, the Highest; glory be to Him, exalted is He, All-glorious, All-holy, our Lord and the Lord of the angels and the Spirit,
سُبْحَانَ الدَّاۤئِمِ غَيْرِ الْغَافِلِ سُبْحَانَ الْعَالِمِ بِغَيْرِ تَعْلِيْمٍ
SUBHAANAD DAAA-IMI GHAYRIL GHAAFIL SUBHAANAL A'ALIMI BI-GHAYRI TA'LEEM
glory be to the Everlasting Who is never heedless, glory be to the All-knowing Who needed no teaching,
سُبْحَانَ خَالِقِ مَا يُرٰى وَ مَا لَا يُرٰى سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ يُدْرِكُ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ لَا تُدْرِكُهُ الْاَبْصَارُ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ
SUBHAANA KHAALIQI MAA YURAA WA MAA LAA YURAA SUBHAANAL LAZEE YUDRIKUL ABSAARA WA LAA TUDRIKUHUL ABSAARU WA HUWAL LATEEFUL KHABEER
glory be to the Creator of what is seen and what is unseen, glory be to Him Who perceives all sights while sights cannot perceive Him, and He is the Subtle, the Aware.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَ خَيْرٍ وَ بَرَكَةٍ وَ عَافِيَةٍ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ
ALLAAHUMMA INNEE ASBAHTU MINKA FEE NI'MATIN WA KHAYRIN WA BARAKATIN WA A'AAFIYATIN FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIH
O Allah, I have entered this morning in blessing, goodness, grace, and well-being from You; so bless Muhammad and his Household,
وَ اَتْمِمْ عَلَيَّ نِعْمَتَكَ وَ خَيْرَكَ وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ عَافِيَتَكَ بِنَجَاةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ
WA ATMIM A'LAYYA NI'MATAKA WA KHAYRAKA WA BARAKAATIKA WA A'AAFIYATAKA BI-NAJAATIM MINAN NAAR
and complete for me Your blessing, Your goodness, Your grace, and Your well-being, with deliverance from the Fire,
وَ ارْزُقْنِيْ شُكْرَكَ وَ عَافِيَتَكَ وَ فَضْلَكَ وَ كَرَامَتَكَ اَبَدًا مَا اَبْقَيْتَنِيْ
WAR ZUQNEE SHUKRAKA WA A'AAFIYATAKA WA FADLAKA WA KARAAMATAKA ABADAM MAA ABQAYTANEE
and grant me gratitude to You, well-being from You, Your bounty, and Your honor, for as long as You let me live.
اَللّٰهُمَّ بِنُوْرِكَ اهْتَدَيْتُ وَ بِفَضْلِكَ اسْتَغْنَيْتُ وَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ اَصْبَحْتُ وَ اَمْسَيْتُ
ALLAAHUMMA BI-NOORIKAH TADAYTU WA BI-FADLIKAS TAGHNAYTU WA BI-NI'MATIKA ASBAHTU WA AMSAYT
O Allah, by Your light I have been guided, by Your bounty I have become needless, and by Your blessing I begin my morning and my evening.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّي اُشْهِدُكَ وَ كَفٰى بِكَ شَهِيْدًا وَ اُشْهِدُ مَلَاۤئِكَتَكَ وَ اَنْبِيَاۤءَكَ وَ رُسُلَكَ وَ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَ سُكَّانَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ وَ اَرْضِكَ وَ جَمِيْعَ خَلْقِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA INNEE USH-HIDUKA WA KAFAA BIKA SHAHEEDAW WA USH-HIDU MALAAA-IKATAKA WA ANBIYAAA-AKA WA RUSULAKA WA HAMALATA A'RSHIKA WA SUKKAANA SAMAAWAATIKA WA ARDIKA WA JAMEE-A' KHALQIKA
O Allah, I call You to witness — and You suffice as a Witness — and I call to witness Your angels, Your prophets, Your messengers, the bearers of Your Throne, the dwellers of Your heavens and Your earth, and all Your creation,
بِاَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ
BI-ANNAKA ANTAL LAAHO LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAKA WA ANNA MUHAMMADAN SALLAL LAAHO A'LAYHI WA AALIHI A'BDUKA WA RASOOLUK
that You are Allah, there is no god but You, alone, with no partner unto You, and that Muhammad — Allah's blessings be upon him and his Household — is Your servant and Your Messenger,
وَ اَنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ تُحْيِيْ وَ تُمِيْتُ وَ تُمِيْتُ وَ تُحْيِيْ
WA ANNAKA A'LAA KULLI SHAY-IN QADEER TUHYEE WA TUMEETU WA TUMEETU WA TUHYEE
and that You have power over all things; You give life and cause death, and You cause death and give life,
وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ حَقٌّ وَ اَنَّ النَّارَ حَقٌّ وَ اَنَّ النُّشُوْرَ حَقٌّ وَ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا وَ اَنَّ اللهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ
WA ASH-HADU ANNAL JANNATA HAQQUW WA ANNAN NAARA HAQQUW WA ANNAN NUSHOORA HAQQUW WAS SAAA-A'TA AATIYATUL LAA RAYBA FEEHAA WA ANNAL LAAHA YAB-A'THU MAN FIL QUBOOR
and I bear witness that Paradise is true, the Fire is true, the Resurrection is true, the Hour is coming with no doubt in it, and that Allah will raise up those who are in the graves.
وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ اَمِيْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ حَقًّا حَقًّا
WA ASH-HADU ANNA A'LEE-YABNA ABEE TAALIBIN AMEERUL MU'MINEENA HAQQAN HAQQAA
And I bear witness that Ali ibn Abi Talib is truly, truly the Commander of the Faithful,
وَ اَنَّ الْاَئِمَّةَ مِنْ وُلْدِهِ هُمُ الْاَئِمَّةُ الْهُدَاةُ الْمَهْدِيُّوْنَ غَيْرُ الضَّآلِّيْنَ وَ لَا الْمُضِلِّيْنَ
WA ANNAL A-IMMATA MIN WULDIHI HUMUL A-IMMATUL HUDAATUL MAHDIYYOONA GHAYRUD DAAA-LLEENA WA LAL MUDILLEEN
and that the Imams of his progeny are the guiding, rightly-guided Imams, neither astray nor leading astray,
وَ اَنَّهُمْ اَوْلِيَاۤؤُكَ الْمُصْطَفُوْنَ وَ حِزْبُكَ الْغَالِبُوْنَ وَ صَفْوَتُكَ وَ خِيَرَتُكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
WA ANNAHUM AWLIYAAA-UKAL MUSTAFAWNA WA HIZBUKAL GHAALIBOONA WA SAFWATUKA WA KHIYARATUKA MIN KHALQIK
and that they are Your chosen intimate friends, Your victorious party, Your elite and Your best from among Your creation,
وَ نُجَبَاۤؤُكَ الَّذِيْنَ انْتَجَبْتَهُمْ لِدِيْنِكَ وَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ اصْطَفَيْتَهُمْ عَلٰى عِبَادِكَ وَ جَعَلْتَهُمْ حُجَّةً عَلَى الْعَالَمِيْنَ
WA NUJABAAA-UKAL LAZEENAN TAJABTAHUM LI-DEENIKA WAKH TASASTAHUM MIN KHALQIKA WAS TAFAYTAHUM A'LAA I'BAADIKA WA JA-A'LTAHUM HUJJATAN A'LAL A'ALAMEEN
and Your chosen ones whom You have selected for Your religion, singled out from Your creation, chosen over Your servants, and made a proof over all the worlds;
صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ السَّلَامُ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
SALAWAATUKA A'LAYHIM WAS SALAAMU WA RAHMATUL LAAHI WA BARAKAATUH
Your blessings, peace, mercy and blessings be upon them.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِيْ هٰذِهِ الشَّهَادَةَ عِنْدَكَ حَتّٰى تُلَقِّنَنِيْهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَ اَنْتَ عَنِّيْ رَاضٍ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى مَا تَشَاۤءُ قَدِيْرٌ
ALLAAHUMMAK TUB LEE HAAZIHISH SHAHAADATA I'NDAKA HATTAA TULAQQINANEEHAA YAWMAL QIYAAMATI WA ANTA A'NNEE RAADIN INNAKA A'LAA MAA TASHAAA-O QADEER
O Allah, record this testimony for me with You, so that You restore it to me on the Day of Resurrection while You are pleased with me; verily You have power over whatever You will.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا يَصْعَدُ اَوَّلُهُ وَ لَا يَنْفَدُ اٰخِرُهُ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAY YAS-A'DU AWWALUHU WA LAA YANFADU AAKHIRUH
O Allah, to You is praise — praise whose beginning ascends and whose end never runs out,
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا تَضَعُ لَكَ السَّمَاۤءُ كَنَفَيْهَا وَ تُسَبِّحُ لَكَ الْاَرْضُ وَ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN TADA-U' LAKAS SAMAAA-O KANAFAYHAA WA TUSABBIHU LAKAL ARDU WA MAN A'LAYHAA
O Allah, to You is praise — praise before which the sky lowers its embrace, and for which the earth and all upon it glorify You,
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا سَرْمَدًا اَبَدًا لَا انْقِطَاعَ لَهُ وَ لَا نَفَادَ وَ لَكَ يَنْبَغِيْ وَ اِلَيْكَ يَنْتَهِيْ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN SARMADAN ABADAL LAA INQITAA-A' LAHU WA LAA NAFAADA WA LAKA YANBAGHEE WA ILAYKA YANTAHEE
O Allah, to You is praise, everlasting praise, with no cessation and no exhaustion, befitting You alone and ending with You,
فِيَّ وَ عَلَيَّ وَ لَدَيَّ وَ مَعِيْ وَ قَبْلِيْ وَ بَعْدِيْ وَ اَمَامِيْ وَ فَوْقِي وَ تَحْتِيْ
FEE-YA WA A'LAYYA WA LADAYYA WA MA-E'E WA QABLEE WA BA'DEE WA AMAAMEE WA FAWQEE WA TAHTEE
regarding me, upon me, with me, alongside me, before me, after me, ahead of me, above me, and beneath me,
وَ اِذَا مِتُّ وَ بَقِيْتُ فَرْدًا وَحِيْدًا ثُمَّ فَنِيْتُ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ اِذَا نُشِرْتُ وَ بُعِثْتُ يَا مَوْلَايَ
WA IZAA MITTU WA BAQEETU FARDAW WAHEEDAN THUMMA FANEETU WA LAKAL HAMDU IZAA NUSHIRTU WA BU-I'THTU YAA MAWLAAYA
and when I die and remain solitary, alone, and then perish; and to You is praise when I am raised up and resurrected, O my Master.
اَللّٰهُمَّ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَ لَكَ الشُّكْرُ بِجَمِيْعِ مَحَامِدِكَ كُلِّهَا عَلٰى جَمِيْعِ نَعْمَاۤئِكَ كُلِّهَا حَتّٰى يَنْتَهِيَ الْحَمْدُ اِلٰى مَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَ تَرْضٰى
ALLAAHUMMA WA LAKAL HAMDU WA LAKASH SHUKRU BI-JAMEE-I' MAHAAMIDIKA KULLIHAA A'LAA JAMEE-I' NA'MAAA-IKA KULLIHAA HATTAA YANTAHIYAL HAMDU ILAA MAA TUHIBBU RABBANAA WA TARDAA
O Allah, to You is praise and to You is thanks, with all Your praises entirely, for all Your favors entirely, until praise arrives at what You love and are pleased with, our Lord.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰى كُلِّ اَكْلَةٍ وَ شَرْبَةٍ وَ بَطْشَةٍ وَ قَبْضَةٍ وَ بَسْطَةٍ وَ فِي كُلِّ مَوْضِعِ شَعْرَةٍ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU A'LAA KULLI AKLATIW WA SHARBATIW WA BATSHATIW WA QABDATIW WA BASTATIW WA FEE KULLI MAWDI-I' SHA'RAH
O Allah, to You is praise for every meal and drink, for every grasp, every clenching and every opening, and for every place of a single hair,
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا خَالِدًا مَعَ خُلُوْدِكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا مُنْتَهٰى لَهُ دُوْنَ عِلْمِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAN KHAALIDAM MA-A' KHULOODIK WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA MUNTAHAA LAHU DOONA I'LMIK
O Allah, to You is praise, everlasting praise along with Your everlastingness, and to You is praise with no limit short of Your knowledge,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا اَمَدَ لَهُ دُوْنَ مَشِيَّتِكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا لَا اَجْرَ لِقَاۤئِلِهِ اِلَّا رِضَاكَ
WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA AMADA LAHU DOONA MASHEE-ATIK WA LAKAL HAMDU HAMDAL LAA AJRA LI-QAAA-ILIHI ILLAA RIDAAK
and to You is praise with no bound short of Your will, and to You is praise whose sayer's only reward is Your good pleasure,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰى حِلْمِكَ بَعْدَ عِلْمِكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلٰى عَفْوِكَ بَعْدَ قُدْرَتِكَ
WA LAKAL HAMDU A'LAA HILMIKA BA'DA I'LMIKA WA LAKAL HAMDU A'LAA A'FWIKA BA'DA QUDRATIK
and to You is praise for Your forbearance despite Your knowledge, and to You is praise for Your pardon despite Your power.
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ بَاعِثَ الْحَمْدِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَارِثَ الْحَمْدِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ بَدِيعَ الْحَمْدِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU BAA-I'THAL HAMD WA LAKAL HAMDU WAARISAL HAMD WA LAKAL HAMDU BADEE-A'L HAMD
and to You is praise, O Initiator of praise; and to You is praise, O Inheritor of praise; and to You is praise, O Originator of praise;
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مُنْتَهَى الْحَمْدِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مُبْتَدِعَ الْحَمْدِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مُشْتَرِيَ الْحَمْدِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU MUNTAHAL HAMD WA LAKAL HAMDU MUBTADI-A'L HAMD WA LAKAL HAMDU MUSHTARIYAL HAMD
and to You is praise, O Utmost of praise; and to You is praise, O Innovator of praise; and to You is praise, O Purchaser of praise;
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلِيَّ الْحَمْدِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ قَدِيْمَ الْحَمْدِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU WALIYYAL HAMD WA LAKAL HAMDU QADEEMAL HAMD
and to You is praise, O Guardian of praise; and to You is praise, O Ancient of praise;
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَفِيَّ الْعَهْدِ عَزِيْزَ الْجُنْدِ قَاۤئِمَ الْمَجْدِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU SAADIQAL WA'D WAFEE-YAL A'HD A'ZEEZAL JUND QAAA-IMAL MAJD
and to You is praise, O Truthful in promise, Faithful to covenant, Mighty in host, Sustainer of glory,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ رَفِيْعَ الدَّرَجَاتِ مُجِيْبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ مُنْزِلَ الْاٰيَاتِ مِنْ فَوْقِ سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتٍ
WA LAKAL HAMDU RAFEE-A'D DARAJAAT MUJEEBAD DA'AWAAT MUNZILAL AAYAATI MIN FAWQI SAB-I' SAMAAWAAT
and to You is praise, O Raiser of ranks, Answerer of supplications, Sender-down of verses from above seven heavens,
عَظِيْمَ الْبَرَكَاتِ مُخْرِجَ النُّوْرِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ وَ مُخْرِجَ مَنْ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ اِلَى النُّوْرِ
A'ZEEMAL BARAKAAT MUKHRIJAN NOORI MINAZ ZULUMAAT WA MUKHRIJA MAN FIZ ZULUMAATI ILAN NOOR
Great in blessings, Bringer of light out of darkness, and Bringer of whoever is in darkness out into light,
مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ حَسَنَاتٍ وَ جَاعِلَ الْحَسَنَاتِ دَرَجَاتٍ
MUBADDILAS SAYYI-AATI HASANAAT WA JAA-I'LAL HASANAATI DARAJAAT
Changer of evil deeds into good deeds, and Maker of good deeds into ranks.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ غَافِرَ الذَّنْبِ وَ قَابِلَ التَّوْبِ شَدِيْدَ الْعِقَابِ ذَا الطَّوْلِ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ اِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU GHAAFIRAZ ZANB WA QAABILAT TAWB SHADEEDAL I'QAAB ZAT TAWL LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA ILAYKAL MASEER
O Allah, to You is praise, O Forgiver of sin, Acceptor of repentance, Severe in punishment, Possessor of bounty; there is no god but You, to You is the ultimate return.
اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِي اللَّيْلِ اِذَا يَغْشٰى وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِي النَّهَارِ اِذَا تَجَلَّى وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ الْاُوْلٰى
ALLAAHUMMA LAKAL HAMDU FIL LAYLI IZAA YAGHSHAA WA LAKAL HAMDU FIN NAHAARI IZAA TAJALLAA WA LAKAL HAMDU FIL AAKHIRATI WAL OOLAA
O Allah, to You is praise in the night when it covers, and to You is praise in the day when it shines forth, and to You is praise in the Last Life and the First,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ كُلِّ نَجْمٍ وَ مَلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاۤءِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ الثَّرٰى وَ الْحَصٰى وَ النَّوٰى
WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA KULLI NAJMIW WA MALAKIN FIS SAMAAA-I WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADATH THARAA WAL HASAA WAN NAWAA
and to You is praise as many as every star and angel in the sky, and to You is praise as many as the specks of dust, the pebbles, and the seeds,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاۤءِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا فِي جَوْفِ الْاَرْضِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA MAA FEE JAWWIS SAMAAA-I WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA MAA FEE JAWFIL ARD
and to You is praise as many as all that is in the expanse of the sky, and to You is praise as many as all that is in the depths of the earth,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ اَوْزَانِ مِيَاهِ الْبِحَارِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ اَوْرَاقِ الْاَشْجَارِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA AWZAANI MIYAAHIL BIHAAR WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA AWRAAQIL ASHJAAR
and to You is praise as much as the weight of the waters of the seas, and to You is praise as many as the leaves of the trees,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا عَلٰى وَجْهِ الْاَرْضِ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا اَحْصٰى كِتَابُكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ مَا اَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA MAA A'LAA WAJHIL ARD WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA MAA AHSAA KITAABUK WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADA MAA AHAATA BIHI I'LMUK
and to You is praise as many as all that is on the face of the earth, and to You is praise as many as all that Your Book has enumerated, and to You is praise as many as all that Your knowledge encompasses,
وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَدَدَ الْاِنْسِ وَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْهَوَاۤمِّ وَ الطَّيْرِ وَ الْبَهَاۤئِمِ وَ السِّبَاعِ
WA LAKAL HAMDU A'DADAL INSI WAL JINNI WAL HAWAAA-MMI WAT TAYRI WAL BAHAAA-IMI WAS SIBAA-A'
and to You is praise as many as mankind, the jinn, the crawling creatures, the birds, the cattle, and the beasts of prey,
حَمْدًا كَثِيْرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيْهِ كَمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَ تَرْضٰى وَ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ وَ عِزِّ جَلَالِكَ
HAMDAN KASEERAN TAYYIBAM MUBAARAKAN FEEHI KAMAA TUHIBBU RABBANAA WA TARDAA WA KAMAA YANBAGHEE LI-KARAMI WAJHIKA WA I'ZZI JALAALIK
a praise abundant, goodly, and blessed, as You love and are pleased with, our Lord, and as befits the generosity of Your Countenance and the might of Your majesty.
Then repeat the following statements ten times each:
لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ
LAA ILAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU LAHUL MULKU WA LAHUL HAMDU WA HUWAL LATEEFUL KHABEER
There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner unto Him; His is the dominion, His is all praise, and He is the Subtle, the Aware.
لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِيْ وَ يُمِيْتُ وَ يُمِيْتُ وَ يُحْيِيْ وَ هُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوْتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
LAA ILAAHA ILLAL LAAHO WAHDAHU LAA SHAREEKA LAHU LAHUL MULKU WA LAHUL HAMDU YUHYEE WA YUMEETU WA YUMEETU WA YUHYEE WA HUWA HAYYUL LAA YAMOOT BI-YADIHIL KHAYR WA HUWA A'LAA KULLI SHAY-IN QADEER
There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner unto Him; His is the dominion and His is all praise; He gives life and causes death, and He causes death and gives life, and He is Ever-living, never dying; in His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِيْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ
ASTAGHFIRUL LAAHAL LAZEE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA HUWAL HAYYUL QAYYOOM WA ATOOBU ILAYH
I seek the forgiveness of Allah, besides Whom there is no god, the Ever-living, the Self-subsisting, and I repent to Him.
يَا اَللهُ يَا اَللهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَحِيْمُ يَا رَحِيْمُ يَا بَدِيْعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْاِكْرَامِ
YAA ALLAAHO YAA ALLAAHO YAA RAHMAANO YAA RAHMAANO YAA RAHEEMO YAA RAHEEMO YAA BADEE-A'S SAMAAWAATI WAL ARD YAA ZAL JALAALI WAL IKRAAM
O Allah, O Allah! O All-beneficent, O All-beneficent! O All-merciful, O All-merciful! O Originator of the heavens and the earth, O Possessor of majesty and honor,
يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ يَا حَيُّ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ يَا اَللهُ يَا لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ
YAA HANNAANO YAA MANNAANO YAA HAYYO YAA QAYYOOMO YAA HAYYO LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA YAA ALLAAHO YAA LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANT
O Most Compassionate, O Most Bounteous, O Ever-living, O Self-subsisting, O Ever-living, there is no god but You; O Allah, O He besides whom there is no god,
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَللّٰهُمَّ افْعَلْ بِي مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ اٰمِيْنَ اٰمِيْنَ
BISMIL LAAHIR RAHMAANIR RAHEEM ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD ALLAAHUMMAF-A'L BEE MAA ANTA AHLUH AAMEEN AAMEEN
In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad. O Allah, do with me that which You are worthy to do. Amen, amen.
(then recite [Surah al-Ikhlas](A116))
You should then say the following:
اَللّٰهُمَّ اصْنَعْ بِيْ مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهُ وَ لَا تَصْنَعْ بِيْ مَا اَنَا اَهْلُهُ
ALLAAHUMMAS NA' BEE MAA ANTA AHLUH WA LAA TASNA' BEE MAA ANAA AHLUH
O Allah, deal with me as You are worthy to do, and do not deal with me as I deserve,
فَاِنَّكَ اَهْلُ التَّقْوٰى وَ اَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ وَ اَنَا اَهْلُ الذُّنُوْبِ وَ الْخَطَايَا فَارْحَمْنِيْ يَا مَوْلَايَ وَ اَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
FA-INNAKA AHLUT TAQWAA WA AHLUL MAGHFIRATI WA ANAA AHLUZ ZUNOOBI WAL KHATAAYAA FARHAMNEE YAA MAWLAAYA WA ANTA ARHAMUR RAAHIMEEN
for You are worthy to be feared, and worthy to forgive, while I am one deserving only of sins and faults; so have mercy on me, O my Master, for You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
Then repeat the following ten times:
لَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِيْ لَا يَمُوْتُ
LAA HAWLA WA LAA QUWWATA ILLAA BILLAAH TAWAKKALTU A'LAL HAYYIL LAZEE LAA YAMOOT
There is no power and no strength except with Allah; I put my trust in the Ever-living Who never dies,
وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيْكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ وَ كَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيْرًا
WAL HAMDU LILLAAHIL LAZEE LAM YATTAKHIZ WALADAW WA LAM YAKUL LAHU SHAREEKUN FIL MULKI WA LAM YAKUL LAHU WALIYYUM MINAZ ZULLI WA KABBIRHU TAKBEERAA
and praise be to Allah, Who has taken no son, has no partner in dominion, and needs no protector out of weakness; so magnify Him with the greatest magnification.
